prompt:
CRITICAL ANTI-TEXT DIRECTIVE: ZERO text of ANY kind. No letters, words, numbers, runes, hieroglyphs, symbols, UI text, watermarks, logos. Use ONLY abstract fracture patterns for decorative markings.

CRITICAL: NO HALO RINGS. No circular discs behind head. No glowing rings.
CRITICAL: NO ANIMALS AT FEET. No companion animals, no creatures. Energy/void patterns only.
CRITICAL: THE HOLLOW IS NOT A PLAYABLE DEITY. This creature must look INCOMPLETE, FRACTURED, CORRUPTED. Where deities radiate divine light, this creature ABSORBS light. Where deities are alive, this creature is ABSENCE. Where deities have faces, this creature has broken or missing masks.
CRITICAL: HOLLOW AESTHETIC — charcoal-black void-stuff body (pure absence given form, NOT metal, NOT stone, NOT flesh). White fracture cracks (cold white lines where light dies, NOT warm energy, NOT fire). Incomplete or broken masks. Broken Gate stone embedded in body (fragments of the original Mythos Gates fused into the form). Negative-space wounds (holes showing ACTIVE NOTHING, the void that consumes). Anti-light seams (absolute black that drinks surrounding light). Ash falling UPWARD (gravity inverts around Hollow creatures).
CRITICAL: NOT EVIL, NOT DEMONIC — the Hollow is EROSION, not malice. It is absence, not corruption with intent. It should feel like looking at a wound in reality, not at a villain. Cold, silent, erasing, not raging or screaming.
CRITICAL: EPIC SCALE — this creature is large but SMALLER than deities. Deities are colossal (hundreds of feet tall). This creature is human-scale to slightly larger (8-15 feet tall). Low camera angle looking up. Show the creature emerging from a Gate fracture or void breach in the ground.
CRITICAL: Readable tactical RPG silhouette — the creature must be readable as a DISRUPTOR unit at a glance. Clear weapon or threat indicator. Distinct silhouette from all other Hollow creatures.

Create Hollow Choirling, for Mythos Gates: Ascension. The Hollow threat faction.
Faction: The Hollow (non-playable threat faction).
Threat Tier: Minor.
Creature Category: Hollow Creature.
Combat Role: DISRUPTOR.
Canon: The Hollow is the anti-civilization that grows in the wound between Realms. It is what the Mythos Gates were built to keep sealed. When the Gates broke, the Hollow came through. This creature carries fragments of broken Gate stone in its body — not as armor, but as the scar of its own creation. Where deities are alive, this creature is absence. Where deities radiate, this creature absorbs.

ART STYLE: Premium dark mythological tactical RPG enemy concept art. Grim dark aesthetic. The Hollow should feel WRONG — like looking at something that should not exist. Not scary in a monster way, but unsettling in an existential way. This is not a demon or a beast — it is a WOUND IN REALITY wearing a shape it stole from something that was real. Painterly textures, deep shadows, void-black depths.

HOLLOW CHOIRLING — A small mouthless choir-husk that hums erased prayers.

BODY: Small, bent humanoid form — hunched over, smaller than a Wretch (5-7 feet). Charcoal-black void-stuff body, but thinner, more fragile-looking. The back is hunched, the arms hang low. The body looks like a child's silhouette that was abandoned mid-drawing — incomplete, fading at the edges, void-stuff thinning to translucency at the extremities.

MASK: Smooth, unfinished face — NO mask fragments, NO features. Just a smooth white-grey oval where a face should be. No eyes, no mouth, no nose. But the THROAT area (neck/upper chest) is full of white fracture lines — dense, web-like, concentrated where the throat would be. These cracks pulse rhythmically, like a pulse or a hum. The Choirling is SILENCING prayer — the fracture lines in its throat are the visual representation of erased hymns.

SHOULDERS: Ash ribbons float from its shoulders — NOT cloth, NOT fire, but strips of void-stuff that drift upward, defying gravity. The ribbons are charcoal-black fading to white at the tips, like burned paper floating upward. They move like they are caught in an updraft, but there is no wind.

GATE STONE: Small fragments embedded along the spine — a row of tiny Gate-stone shards running down the back, like vertebrae made of broken arch stone. Faint cold white anti-light between them.

POSE: Standing still, head tilted back slightly, arms hanging limp. Not threatening — more like something frozen mid-hymn. The pose should feel WRONG — a choir singer with no mouth, no song, no sound. Several Choirlings visible in background, all standing in the same frozen pose, forming a silent chorus.

SCALE: Small — 5-7 feet. Camera at eye level or slightly above. The Choirling looks small and fragile but deeply unsettling. Rubble and broken Gate-fragments at its feet.

GROUND: The ground around the Choirling is SILENT — no cracks, no anti-light, but the ground itself looks dampened, deadened, like sound has been erased from the area. Grey-white void-fog pooling at its feet. Ash falling upward in slow spirals.

BACKGROUND: Dark void environment with faint broken Gate-arches in distance. The atmosphere should feel SUPPRESSED — like a room where all sound has been removed. Cold, muted, grey. Palette: charcoal-black, ash-grey, cold white, muted blue-white.

VFX: Sound-suppression visual — the air around the Choirling looks THICKER, like sound is being absorbed. The white fracture lines in its throat pulse rhythmically. Ash ribbons drifting upward. Faint anti-light absorption around its body.

SILHOUETTE: Small, bent, fragile. Reads as a support/disruptor unit — small, not physically threatening, but the wrong one to ignore. The tilted-back head and hanging arms should read as "choir singer" silhouette, but WRONG.
